Add the reference when the conversation starts.\r\n\r\n## Current state\r\n\r\nThe desktop sends an `agentStarted` update containing the new conversation and its `conversation.path` reference. `AgentIntegration` receives this update but does not add the reference to the card.\r\n\r\nThe reference is currently added only when the terminal `action` event arrives. If the app closes before that event, the card never receives the reference.\r\n\r\n## implementation details\r\n\r\n- When `AgentIntegration` receives an `agentStarted` update for a card-scoped action, add `update.conversation.path` to that card's `agents` header through the existing card save path.\r\n- Do not load the conversation from the activity file at this point. The running conversation is already held by `ActionRunRegistry`, and the existing terminal event remains responsible for loading the completed conversation.\r\n- Keep reference insertion idempotent so continuations and the terminal event do not add duplicates.\r\n- Do not change when or how the activity file itself is written.\r\n- Add a regression test showing that `agentStarted` updates the card before any terminal event is received. Keep the existing terminal linking and loading test.\r\n\r\n## acceptance criteria\r\n\r\n- A card-scoped `agentStarted` update adds the conversation reference to the card immediately, without waiting for completion.\r\n- If the app closes during the conversation after that card save is persisted, reopening the project still shows the reference in the card header.\r\n- A continuation or terminal event does not add the same reference twice.\r\n- Existing activity-file persistence behavior is unchanged.\r\n\n===== F_102_select_empty_conversation.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor: \r\nid: F_102\r\ninternalId: c5d963f2-ca43-419d-bc3c-972199b7e7cd\r\ntitle: select empty conversation\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner: \r\naffects:\r\nagents:\r\npolicy:\r\nafter: 8e4a295a-8788-4232-8be7-c97f5a1cf5c8\r\n---\r\n\r\nWhen an action has historical logs and the user selects one, he is no longer able to select an empty 'conversation'\r\n\r\nThe first item in the context menu is disabled. This is wrong, the user should be able to select it so that he can go back to an empty conversation (the 'now' conversation)\r\n\r\n# Current state\r\n\r\n`ActionConversationPicker` displays `Conversations` as its empty item but disables it. After history is selected, `handleConversationChange` only loads persisted paths, so popup cannot return to empty conversation state.\r\n\r\n# Implementation details\r\n\r\n- Keep empty `Conversations` item selectable while picker is enabled.\r\n- Treat empty value as reset: clear selected conversation and displayed chat without calling conversation loader.\r\n- Next run omits `continueFrom` and starts new conversation.\r\n\r\n# Acceptance criteria\r\n\r\n- User can select `Conversations` after selecting historical conversation.\r\n- Popup returns to empty conversation without error or empty-path load.\r\n- Next run starts new conversation; selecting history still continues selected conversation.\r\n- Picker and controller tests cover reset and continuation behavior.\r\n\n===== F_115_add_support_for_request_approval.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor: \r\nid: F_115\r\ninternalId: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\r\ntitle: add support for request approval\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner: \r\naffects:\r\nagents:\r\npolicy:\r\nafter: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\r\n---\r\n# Current state\r\n\r\n`CodexStreamingAdapter` handles structured questions, but not Codex app-server approval requests. `item/fileChange/requestApproval` and `item/commandExecution/requestApproval` fall through as protocol diagnostics, for example `item/fileChange/requestApproval: unknown (...)`. No approval UI or JSON-RPC response exists, so the turn remains blocked.\r\n\r\n# Implementation details\r\n\r\n- Handle both approval methods as server-initiated JSON-RPC requests before notification handling. Validate request, item, thread, and turn ids; track pending requests by request id; clear them on `serverRequest/resolved`.\r\n- Add a dedicated approval contract through `AgentRunnerService`, action execution events, Electron preload/local bridge, and remote control. Respond with `{ decision }`; for command requests, honor `availableDecisions` when supplied. Keep approvals separate from structured questions and conversation messages.\r\n- Store pending approvals in `ActionExecutionService`. Keep execution `waitingForInput` while any question or approval remains. Replay must restore unresolved approvals and discard resolved ones after renderer reload.\r\n- Add a separate popup approval component. Show reason plus command, working directory, parsed actions, network host/protocol, requested permissions, or affected file paths when available. Actions sit bottom-right: allow once, allow for session, decline, and stop turn. Show policy-amendment choices only when Codex supplies them.\r\n- Support multiple pending approvals without overwriting one another. Disable a submitted request until response or resolution; reject duplicate, stale, mismatched, or unsupported decisions clearly.\r\n- Do not persist approval requests or decisions in conversation/activity files or agent handoff context. Existing completed command/file activity remains authoritative.\r\n- Add adapter, runner, execution-contract, bridge, remote-control, service, popup, reload, and regression tests. Run lint and tests in `desktop/` and `app/`.\r\n\r\n# Acceptance criteria\r\n\r\n- File-change and command-execution approval requests show actionable prompts instead of protocol diagnostics.\r\n- Allow once/session, decline, stop-turn, and offered policy-amendment choices send the exact matching JSON-RPC decision and unblock Codex.\r\n- Approval UI shows available security context before user decides, including network-specific context when present.\r\n- Concurrent requests remain isolated; `serverRequest/resolved`, turn completion, or cancellation removes only matching pending requests.\r\n- Renderer reload and remote-control clients retain correct pending approval state.\r\n- Structured questions, activity ordering, changed-path tracking, and conversation persistence keep existing behavior; approval data is not persisted.\r\n\n===== F_89_add_support_for_clicking_on_links_in_chatlogs.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor: \r\nid: F_89\r\ninternalId: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\r\ntitle: add support for clicking on links in chatlogs\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner: \r\naffects:\r\nagents:\r\npolicy:\r\nafter: e69b9faf-30dd-4ad6-9d99-7e6af4d18c76\r\n---\r\nSometimes the agent produces a link to a local project file. Currently, when the user clicks on this link, the system crashes.\r\n\r\nWhat should happen: if it is a md file or action-json file in the design folder (or subfolder), show it in the list view with the correct editor. Otherwise, open it with vscode (externally)\r\n\r\n## Current state\r\n\r\n`ActionConversationChat` renders messages with `ReactMarkdown` without a custom link handler. Local paths therefore use browser navigation and can crash the Electron renderer.\r\n\r\nThe app already opens loaded Markdown and action-definition JSON files through `workspaceNavigationService` and `openFilesService`. VS Code opening exists through the Electron `openInEditor` bridge, but is currently used only for diff lines.\r\n\r\n## Implementation details\r\n\r\n- Intercept local-file links in `ActionConversationChat`; prevent browser navigation and report failures through `dialogService`.\r\n- Accept repository-relative paths and absolute Windows paths. Normalize separators and convert paths inside the active repository to repository-relative paths.\r\n- When the target is inside configured `projectFolder` and is either a Markdown file or a loaded action-definition JSON file, switch to list view and open its existing Markdown or action editor.\r\n- Open every other local project file in VS Code through the Electron bridge. Keep normal web-link behavior unchanged.\r\n- Reject paths outside the active repository and missing targets without crashing.\r\n\r\n## Acceptance criteria\r\n\r\n- Clicking relative or absolute Windows links to Markdown files under configured `projectFolder` opens them in list view with the Markdown editor.\r\n- Clicking relative or absolute Windows links to action-definition JSON files under configured `projectFolder` opens them in list view with the action editor.\r\n- Clicking another local project-file link opens that file in VS Code.\r\n- Invalid, missing, or out-of-project file links show an error and leave app usable.\r\n- Tests cover path normalization, internal editor routing, VS Code fallback, and error handling.\r\n\n===== F_90_redesign_add_new_card_dialog.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor: \r\nid: F_90\r\ninternalId: eb3a4820-0edb-4161-8fe5-926a981d2c8f\r\ntitle: redesign add new card dialog\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner: \r\naffects:\r\nagents:\r\npolicy:\r\nafter: d97a054f-5a67-47bb-9070-df874cf9148e\r\n---\r\nReference mockup: `New Card Dialog.dc.html` (desktop + mobile side by side, light/dark toggle top-right).\r\nStyle tokens and component conventions: `STYLE_GUIDE.md`.\r\n\r\n## Why\r\n\r\nThe current dialog is low-value and hard to scan:\r\n\r\n* The markdown template (Goal / Current status / Details / Tasks) is pre-inserted and rendered as large bold headings, so it dominates the dialog, doesn't look editable, and must be deleted for most cards.\r\n* Title â€” the one field that always matters â€” is visually secondary.\r\n* Type is a dropdown, which costs two clicks for a short, known list.\r\n* The footer's \"Adds to \\<column>\" is static text, so the target column can't be changed without closing the dialog.\r\n* Net result: That work must consume the single entry list and must not preserve the current merge-and-sort path.\r\n\r\n## Terminology\r\n\r\n- **Conversation entry**: one ordered item in an agent conversation.\r\n- **Message entry**: user or assistant text.\r\n- **Event entry**: reasoning, tool use, command execution, diagnostics, failures, and lifecycle observations.\r\n\r\nDo not use **activity** for a conversation entry, field, helper, component, or collection. `activity` remains valid only for the separate card/project activity-storage domain.\r\n\r\n## Current architecture\r\n\r\nPersisted `AgentConversation` stores `messages` and `events` separately. Live execution repeats the split as `LiveAgentTurn.messages` and `LiveAgentTurn.activities`. Producers append or replace items in those separate collections, while chat and transcript consumers merge and sort them by `sequence` to reconstruct ingestion order.\r\n\r\nThe split causes:\r\n\r\n- duplicate persisted and live representations;\r\n- inconsistent `event`/`activity` terminology;\r\n- repeated merge and sort work in consumers;\r\n- a rebuilt full `AgentConversation` projection in the popup controller;\r\n- ordering behavior owned by presentation code instead of the producer.\r\n\r\n## Required model\r\n\r\nUse a discriminated union and one collection:\r\n\r\n```ts\r\n\n===== J_021_derive_markdown_styles_globally.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-021\r\ninternalId: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\r\ntitle: derive active Markdown content styles once in the global theme\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/theme/theme_context.ts\r\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.tsx\r\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.test.tsx\r\n  - app/src/theme/use_app_theme.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_style_sx.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/config/markdown_style_preview.tsx\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nBuild the active Markdown content styling once when the global Markdown style configuration changes. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\r\n\r\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\r\n\r\n## Current architecture\r\n\r\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Both `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` call `buildMarkdownContentSx(markdownStyleConfig)` in their render bodies. The builder creates a new nested MUI style object even when the configuration is unchanged.\r\n\r\n`MarkdownStylePreview` also calls the builder, but it renders an explicit configuration draft rather than the active global style.\r\n\r\n## Required change\r\n\r\n- Derive a stable `markdownContentSx` value in `AppThemeProvider` with `useMemo`, depending only on `markdownStyleConfig`.\r\n- Expose the derived value through `AppThemeContextValue` and its fallback value.\r\n- Make `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` consume `markdownContentSx` directly.\r\n- Do not call `buildMarkdownContentSx` from either component.\r\n- Keep `buildMarkdownContentSx` as a pure derivation function owned by the theme/style layer.\r\n- Memoize `MarkdownStylePreview`'s derived style by its explicit `config` prop. The preview cannot consume the active global style because it must show unsaved draft configuration.\r\n- Do not introduce a service class; this is a pure derived theme value.\r\n\r\n## Identity contract\r\n\r\n- `markdownContentSx` retains object identity across renders when `markdownStyleConfig` is unchanged.\r\n- Changing palette mode, popup state, editor content, conversation content, or unrelated configuration does not rebuild it.\r\n- Changing the active Markdown style configuration rebuilds it once and updates all active Markdown consumers.\r\n- Changing the preview's explicit draft configuration rebuilds only the preview value.\r\n\r\n## Testing implications\r\n\r\n- Theme-provider tests prove the derived style is exposed and retains identity across unrelated provider renders.\r\n- Theme-provider tests prove changing `markdownStyleConfig` replaces the derived value.\r\n\n===== J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-022\r\ninternalId: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\r\ntitle: move action prompt drafts out of popup React state\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_prompt_draft.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_prompt.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\r\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nGive each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\r\n\r\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\r\n\r\n## Current architecture\r\n\r\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\r\n\r\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\r\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\r\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\r\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\r\n\r\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\r\n\r\n## Required ownership\r\n\r\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\r\n\r\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\r\n\r\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\r\n\r\n- current Markdown value;\r\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\r\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\r\n- local edit without React parent state;\r\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\r\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\r\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\r\n\r\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\r\n\r\n\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-023\r\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\r\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\r\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\r\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. A growing conversation and a persisted conversation are the same `AgentConversation`; persistence is only a lifecycle state.\r\n\r\n## Current problem\r\n\r\nJ-020 unified conversation content into `entries`, but renderer run state still stores `LiveAgentTurn`. `useActionPopupController` converts that object into a new `AgentConversation` during rendering. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\r\n\r\n## Required change\r\n\r\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\r\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\r\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\r\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation's `entries` without changing entry order.\r\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\r\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\r\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\r\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\r\n\r\n## Acceptance criteria\r\n\r\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\r\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\r\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\r\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\r\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\r\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\r\n\r\n## Dependency\r\n\r\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\r\n\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-024\r\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\r\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\r\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\r\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_runner_service.js\r\n  - desktop/src/shell/local_bridge_dispatch.js\r\n  - desktop/src/shell/preload.js\r\n  - shared/card_activity.mjs\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nReplace execution terminology and the global renderer snapshot with action-run terminology, a routing registry, and stable scoped run stores.\r\n\r\n## Terminology\r\n\r\n- `runId`, not `executionId`.\r\n- `ActionRun`, not `LiveActionExecution` or action execution.\r\n- `ActionRunRegistry`, not `ActionExecutionService`.\r\n- `ActionRunStore`: stable state owner for one run.\r\n- `runs`, not `executions`.\r\n- `ConversationEntry` remains reserved for items inside an agent conversation.\r\n\r\nRename the contract consistently across Electron, bridge messages, renderer services, hooks, persisted action records, errors, and tests. Process execution may keep that term only where it refers to an operating-system process.\r\n\r\n## Registry shape\r\n\r\n`ActionRunRegistry` keeps one renderer-wide bridge subscription and a routing map from `runId` to stable `ActionRunStore`. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\r\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\r\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\r\n\n===== F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor: \r\nid: F_96\r\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\r\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner: \r\naffects:\r\nagents:\r\npolicy:\r\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\r\n---\r\n\r\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\r\n\r\n# Current state\r\n\r\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. Diff commands resolve it to the opened project folder.\r\n- Action editor insertion controls and user documentation expose only the existing placeholder.\r\n\r\n## implementation details\r\n\r\n- Replace `{{rootProjectFolder}}` everywhere with `{{worktree-folder}}` and `{{project-folder}}`; do not keep a legacy alias.\r\n- `{{worktree-folder}}` resolves to the absolute execution checkout path. Array position is ingestion order and is the only display order.\r\n\r\nThis refactor must land before the action-popup rendering-isolation work. That work must consume the single entry list and must not preserve the current merge-and-sort path.\r\n\r\n## Terminology\r\n\r\n- **Conversation entry**: one ordered item in an agent conversation.\r\n- **Message entry**: user or assistant text.\r\n- **Event entry**: reasoning, tool use, command execution, diagnostics, failures, and lifecycle observations.\r\n\r\nDo not use **activity** for a conversation entry, field, helper, component, or collection. `activity` remains valid only for the separate card/project activity-storage domain.\r\n\r\n## Current architecture\r\n\r\nPersisted `AgentConversation` stores `messages` and `events` separately. Live execution repeats the split as `LiveAgentTurn.messages` and `LiveAgentTurn.activities`. Producers append or replace items in those separate collections, while chat and transcript consumers merge and sort them by `sequence` to reconstruct ingestion order.\r\n\r\nThe split causes:\r\n\r\n- duplicate persisted and live representations;\r\n- inconsistent `event`/`activity` terminology;\r\n- repeated merge and sort work in consumers;\r\n- a rebuilt full `AgentConversation` projection in the popup controller;\r\n- ordering behavior owned by presentation code instead of the producer.\r\n\r\n## Required model\r\n\r\nUse a discriminated union and one collection:\r\n\r\n```ts\r\n\n===== J_021_derive_markdown_styles_globally.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-021\r\ninternalId: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\r\ntitle: derive active Markdown content styles once in the global theme\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/theme/theme_context.ts\r\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.tsx\r\n  - app/src/theme/theme_provider.test.tsx\r\n  - app/src/theme/use_app_theme.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_style_sx.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/editor/markdown_editor.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/config/markdown_style_preview.tsx\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 4edefccb-f7e3-4ae1-9c0d-5939ac1d3745\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nBuild the active Markdown content styling once when the global Markdown style configuration changes. Components that render active Markdown consume the stable derived style and never rebuild it during unrelated renders.\r\n\r\nThis job is independent of the action-popup subscription refactor and should land before performance verification of that refactor.\r\n\r\n## Current architecture\r\n\r\n`AppThemeProvider` owns `markdownStyleConfig`, but consumers receive only the raw configuration. Both `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` call `buildMarkdownContentSx(markdownStyleConfig)` in their render bodies. The builder creates a new nested MUI style object even when the configuration is unchanged.\r\n\r\n`MarkdownStylePreview` also calls the builder, but it renders an explicit configuration draft rather than the active global style.\r\n\r\n## Required change\r\n\r\n- Derive a stable `markdownContentSx` value in `AppThemeProvider` with `useMemo`, depending only on `markdownStyleConfig`.\r\n- Expose the derived value through `AppThemeContextValue` and its fallback value.\r\n- Make `MarkdownEditor` and `ActionConversationChat` consume `markdownContentSx` directly.\r\n- Do not call `buildMarkdownContentSx` from either component.\r\n- Keep `buildMarkdownContentSx` as a pure derivation function owned by the theme/style layer.\r\n- Memoize `MarkdownStylePreview`'s derived style by its explicit `config` prop. The preview cannot consume the active global style because it must show unsaved draft configuration.\r\n- Do not introduce a service class; this is a pure derived theme value.\r\n\r\n## Identity contract\r\n\r\n- `markdownContentSx` retains object identity across renders when `markdownStyleConfig` is unchanged.\r\n- Changing palette mode, popup state, editor content, conversation content, or unrelated configuration does not rebuild it.\r\n- Changing the active Markdown style configuration rebuilds it once and updates all active Markdown consumers.\r\n- Changing the preview's explicit draft configuration rebuilds only the preview value.\r\n\r\n## Testing implications\r\n\r\n- Theme-provider tests prove the derived style is exposed and retains identity across unrelated provider renders.\r\n- Theme-provider tests prove changing `markdownStyleConfig` replaces the derived value.\r\n\n===== J_022_stabilize_action_prompt_drafts.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-022\r\ninternalId: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\r\ntitle: move action prompt drafts out of popup React state\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_prompt_draft.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_prompt.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\r\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 11ffc4ac-44e0-4dab-a8d9-af9e83a43aff\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nGive each action prompt draft one lifetime-stable external store. Typing, flushing, preparing, replacing, clearing, restoring, and remotely synchronizing a prompt must not place the prompt text or reset counters in `ActionPopupContent` or its controller React state.\r\n\r\nThis job must land before the major action-popup ownership and subscription refactor.\r\n\r\n## Current architecture\r\n\r\nPrompt ownership is duplicated:\r\n\r\n- `useActionPopupController` stores prompt value, preparation status, and reset token in React state.\r\n- `ActionPopupContent` creates a new `ActionPromptDraft` whenever the controller prompt or reset token changes.\r\n- `ActionPromptDraft` buffers live editor values and supports a narrow bottom-row subscription.\r\n- `ActionExecutionService` separately stores prompt values, revisions, pending bridge writes, and remote prompt sessions.\r\n\r\nOrdinary typing already stays out of root React state because `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange` writes to `ActionPromptDraft`. Editor flush still calls `setPromptState`, and external preparation/replacement/clear operations update root state and replace the draft object. Those paths rerender the complete popup.\r\n\r\n## Required ownership\r\n\r\nCreate one prompt-draft service that owns stable draft stores keyed by the action context and, when applicable, the active agent session. The service is justified because it owns state, draft lifecycle, asynchronous bridge synchronization, revisions, and pending writes.\r\n\r\nMove the current prompt-draft map and remote prompt-session behavior out of `ActionExecutionService`. The renamed run/session service planned by the later popup refactor must not retain prompt text ownership.\r\n\r\nEach stable draft store exposes, at minimum:\r\n\r\n- current Markdown value;\r\n- preparation state: `loading`, `ready`, or `failed`;\r\n- a narrow subscription contract suitable for `useSyncExternalStore`;\r\n- local edit without React parent state;\r\n- external replacement that notifies the editor to call `setMarkdown` once;\r\n- clear, flush/synchronize, send, and current-value reads;\r\n- revision protection for superseded asynchronous preparation and remote writes.\r\n\r\nDo not add arbitrary retention limits or silent eviction. Draft removal must follow explicit lifecycle events such as successful send, deliberate clear, action removal, or project teardown. A popup unmount does not discard an unsent draft.\r\n\r\n\n===== J_023_use_one_agent_conversation_model.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-023\r\ninternalId: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\r\ntitle: use one agent conversation model while growing and persisted\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\r\n  - app/src/data/data_types.ts\r\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/agent/agent_runner_service.js\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 5b39ff1e-4bbc-4d50-b527-36e1d1faa6f5\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nFollow J-020 by removing the remaining `LiveAgentTurn` model. This duplicates models, metadata, and ownership.\r\n\r\n## Required change\r\n\r\n- Remove `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation`.\r\n- Store `AgentConversation | null` directly in run state.\r\n- Make the agent-start event provide the complete canonical conversation snapshot, including identity, metadata, path, status, and initial entries.\r\n- Apply later message/event updates immutably to that conversation's `entries` without changing entry order.\r\n- Apply status and completion metadata to the same model.\r\n- Persist and reload the same `AgentConversation` shape.\r\n- Continuation starts from the canonical source conversation and adds new entries without a renderer-side merge.\r\n- Do not add live/persisted adapters, compatibility shapes, or duplicated fields.\r\n\r\n## Acceptance criteria\r\n\r\n- [ ] `LiveAgentTurn` and `liveAgentConversation` no longer exist.\r\n- [ ] Growing, completed, persisted, loaded, and continued conversations all use `AgentConversation`.\r\n- [ ] Run state exposes the canonical conversation directly.\r\n- [ ] Popup rendering performs no conversation-shape conversion or history merge.\r\n- [ ] Entry identity and order remain stable during streamed updates.\r\n- [ ] App and desktop lint and tests pass.\r\n\r\n## Dependency\r\n\r\nJ-020 must be implemented first.\r\n\n===== J_024_replace_execution_state_with_scoped_action_runs.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-024\r\ninternalId: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\r\ntitle: replace global execution state with scoped action runs\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/data/action_run_types.ts\r\n  - app/src/data/electron_action_bridge.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/hooks/use_action_executions.ts\r\n  - app/src/services/actions/action_execution_service.ts\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_execution.js\r\n  - desktop/src/actions/action/action_runner_service.js\r\n  - desktop/src/shell/local_bridge_dispatch.js\r\n  - desktop/src/shell/preload.js\r\n  - shared/card_activity.mjs\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 1244ac27-293a-4a5f-b478-0890ecc3fea6\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nReplace execution terminology and the global renderer snapshot with action-run terminology, a routing registry, and stable scoped run stores.\r\n\r\n## Terminology\r\n\r\n- `runId`, not `executionId`.\r\n- `ActionRun`, not `LiveActionExecution` or action execution.\r\n- `ActionRunRegistry`, not `ActionExecutionService`.\r\n- `ActionRunStore`: stable state owner for one run.\r\n- `runs`, not `executions`.\r\n- `ConversationEntry` remains reserved for items inside an agent conversation.\r\n\r\nRename the contract consistently across Electron, bridge messages, renderer services, hooks, persisted action records, errors, and tests. Process execution may keep that term only where it refers to an operating-system process.\r\n\r\n## Registry shape\r\n\r\n`ActionRunRegistry` keeps one renderer-wide bridge subscription and a routing map from `runId` to stable `ActionRunStore`. Unrelated run changes must preserve selected store snapshots and must not render their consumers.\r\n\r\n## Persistence and lifecycle\r\n\r\n\n===== J_025_move_action_popup_state_to_leaf_owners.md =====\r\n---\r\nauthor:\r\nid: J-025\r\ninternalId: 96705093-a302-409d-b626-fe3e16fd28e2\r\ntitle: move action popup state and subscriptions to leaf owners\r\nstatus: ready\r\nowner:\r\naffects:\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_content.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/use_action_popup_controller.ts\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_selector.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_conversation_chat.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_log_error_display.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_approval.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_agent_question.tsx\r\n  - app/src/components/actions/action_popup_bottom_row.tsx\r\npolicy:\r\n  checkLinting: true\r\n  requireTests: true\r\nafter: 1975a005-f0bb-432f-8ecb-bc85a27819d2\r\n---\r\n\r\n## Goal\r\n\r\nMake popup roots own layout and selection only. Only layout, control sizing, and chrome differ. Breakpoint should follow whatever the app already uses; do not introduce a new one.\n\n***\n\n## Field order and behavior (both platforms)\n\n### 1. Title â€” primary field\n\n* First element in the body, autofocused on open.\n* Visually the largest input: \\~17px/600 on desktop, \\~18px/600 on mobile.\n* Placeholder `Card titleâ€¦`.\n* Required. Create is disabled (or shows an inline error) while empty. Trim before submit.\n\n### 2. Type â€” single-select pill row\n\n* Replaces the dropdown with one-click pills.\n* **Types are dynamic.** Render one pill per type from the app's existing type source (same source the board/card already uses). Do not hard-code type names, count, or order â€” the row must work for 2 types or 12.\n* **Colors are dynamic.** Each pill shows a small round dot (8px) filled with that type's own color, taken from the type record. Never hard-code hex values per type; if a type has no color, fall back to a neutral token (`--text-4`).\n* Selected state: tinted background + border in the app's primary token, primary text color. Unselected: subtle track background, secondary text, transparent border; hover raises contrast.\n* Default selection: the app's existing default type (first in the list if there is no configured default).\n* Overflow: desktop wraps to multiple lines; mobile scrolls horizontally in one row (no wrap, no visible scrollbar chrome).\n* Keyboard: arrow keys move between pills, Space/Enter selects; the row is a single tab stop (radiogroup semantics â€” `role=\"radiogroup\"` with `role=\"radio\"` + `aria-checked` children).\n\n### 3. Description â€” markdown text area, on-demand template\n\n* Labeled `Description`, with a quiet `Markdown` hint next to the label on desktop.\n* Monospace font at 13.5px, line-height \\~1.7, so it reads as editable source rather than rendered output.\n* Generously tall by default: \\~270px desktop, \\~260px mobile. Desktop is vertically resizable; mobile is not.\n* **Template is opt-in, not pre-filled.** A small `Template` button sits on the label row. Clicking inserts the markdown scaffold as plain editable text; the button then reads `Clear` and reverts the field. Rationale: most cards don't need all sections, and pre-filling forces deletion and makes an empty form look full.\n  * Only offer `Clear` while the body is still exactly the untouched template; once the user edits it, the button returns to `Template` and inserting again should append rather than overwrite. Never silently discard user-typed content.\n  * The template body itself should come from config, not be hard-coded in the component, so it can be edited later. (Optional follow-up, only if the team wants it: per-type templates keyed off the selected type â€” needs a template field on the type record, and switching type must not clobber edited text.)\n\n### 4. Target column â€” real control, not a label\n\n* Footer control reading `Add to <column>`, with the column's dot and name, opening the column list.\n* Defaults to the column the dialog was launched from.\n* The chosen column is what the card is created in.\n\n***\n\n## Platform specifics\n\n### Desktop dialog\n\n* \\~480px wide, auto height, on a dim scrim; card surface, 14px radius, elevated shadow, 1px border.\n* Header: small square primary-tinted icon tile with a plus glyph, title `New card`, spacer, icon-only close button on the right.\n* Footer bar (separated by a top border, page-background fill): column picker on the left, then `Cancel` (secondary) and `Create card` (primary) on the right.\n* **This is a Windows app** â€” the keyboard hint chip inside the primary button reads `Ctrl+â†µ`, not `âŒ˜â†µ`. Use Windows modifier labels everywhere.\n* Shortcuts: `Ctrl+Enter` submits from anywhere in the form (including the textarea); `Esc` cancels. If the form has unsaved content, `Esc` should confirm before discarding.\n* Button order follows the app's existing dialogs (`Run Dialog.dc.html`) â€” do not invent a new order for this one dialog.\n\n### Mobile sheet\n\n* Full-height sheet filling the viewport below the status bar; the body scrolls, header and footer are pinned.\n* Header: `Cancel` (left, secondary), `New card` (centered title), `Create` (right, primary-colored text). The top-bar Create and the footer button are the same action â€” keep them in sync for disabled state.\n* Pinned footer, two rows: the column picker row above a full-width `Create card` button. Two rows because the picker opens its own list and needs its own tappable row; side by side would squeeze both below a comfortable touch width.\n  * Acceptable alternative if a single-row footer is preferred: move the column picker up into the scrolling body as a normal field and pin only the Create button.\n* All touch targets â‰¥ 44px tall; type pills 40px.\n* Add safe-area bottom padding so the footer clears the home indicator.\n\n***\n\n## Visual system\n\n* Use only existing tokens from `STYLE_GUIDE.md` â€” surface, page, track, hover, border, border-strong, text-1â€¦4, primary, primary-strong, primary-bg, on-primary. No new colors.\n* Must render correctly in light and dark themes; verify pill selected/unselected contrast in both.\n* Focus rings: 1px primary border + 3px primary-tinted ring on every input and textarea, matching existing fields.\n* Radii: 8â€“9px desktop controls, 11â€“12px mobile controls, 14px dialog.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n* [ ] Opening the dialog focuses Title; the description is empty (no template text).\n* [ ] Type pills are generated from the dynamic type list with per-type colors from data; adding, removing, renaming, or recoloring a type is reflected with no code change.\n* [ ] Selecting a type is one click; selection is visible in both themes; keyboard-navigable as a radiogroup.\n* [ ] `Template` inserts editable markdown; `Clear` removes it; user edits are never lost without confirmation.\n* [ ] Description is at least \\~260px tall by default and monospace.\n* [ ] The target column can be changed in the dialog and the card is created in the chosen column.\n* [ ] `Ctrl+Enter` creates, `Esc` cancels (with confirm when dirty); no Mac modifier labels anywhere.\n* [ ] Create is disabled while Title is empty, on both platforms and in both mobile Create affordances.\n* [ ] Mobile: body scrolls, header/footer pinned, all targets â‰¥ 44px, footer clears the home indicator.\n\r\n\n===== design\\releases\\0_0_4\\F_91_remove_finished_reasoning_blocks.md =====\r\n---\nauthor: \nid: F_91\ninternalId: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\ntitle: remove finished reasoning blocks\nstatus: ready\nowner: \naffects:\nagents:\npolicy:\nafter: eb3a4820-0edb-4161-8fe5-926a981d2c8f\n---\n\nwhen a reasoning output of an agent finishes, we should remove the block\n\n## Current state\n\nCodex reasoning is stored as an `AgentConversationEvent`. Streaming updates replace the same event by `providerItemId`, changing its status from `inProgress` to `completed`. `ActionConversationChat` currently renders every reasoning event, so completed reasoning blocks remain visible during the live run and in reopened conversations. Failed and declined reasoning already use the error presentation.\n\n## implementation details\n\n- Filter conversation feed activities in `ActionConversationChat`: omit only events where `type === 'reasoning'` and `status === 'completed'`.\n- Keep in-progress, failed, declined and unknown-status reasoning visible.\n- Keep completed reasoning events in conversation data and persisted history; this is a presentation-only change.\n- Update chat tests for live completion, reopened conversations, failed/declined reasoning and unaffected non-reasoning activities.\n\n## acceptance criteria\n\n- In-progress reasoning is visible.\n- A reasoning block disappears when its status becomes `completed`, including after reopening a conversation.\n- Failed and declined reasoning remains visible with its error state and content.\n- Completed non-reasoning activities remain visible.\n\r\n\n===== design\\releases\\0_0_4\\F_94_no_prefill_prompt_running_conv.md =====\r\n---\nauthor: \nid: F_94\ninternalId: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\ntitle: no prefill prompt running conv\nstatus: ready\nowner: \naffects:\nagents:\npolicy:\nafter: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\n---\n\nWhen an agent is waiting for a response, but the action popup was closed or on the wrong 'action', then when the user clicks on the action to view the conversation and answer, the input box is prefilled again with the action's prompt. this is annoying cause it needs to be removed.\n\nso, when activating an action that has a running conversation, don't prefill the input\n\n# Current state\n\n`useActionPopupController` prepares an action's stored prompt for a new conversation. When popup opens on another action, or reopens while execution state is being restored, that prepared prompt can remain in `promptState` when user selects action with a `queued`, `running`, or `waitingForInput` conversation.\n\n# Implementation details\n\n- Give active execution its own prompt identity, including before active-child metadata arrives.\n- When active action is selected, seed editor only from its shared user-entered draft; otherwise show empty input.\n- Invalidate pending prompt preparation and bump `promptResetToken` when action becomes active.\n- Keep stored-prompt prefill for idle actions starting new conversations. Keep command actions unchanged.\n\n# Acceptance criteria\n\n- Selecting or reopening action with active conversation does not prefill its stored action prompt.\n- Existing user-entered draft for active conversation is restored.\n- Late prompt-preparation result cannot overwrite active conversation input.\n- Idle agent actions still prefill stored prompt.\n- Controller and popup tests cover action switching, popup reopen, draft restore, and preparation race.\n\r\n\n===== design\\releases\\0_0_4\\F_95_integrate_into_project_should_track_commit.md =====\r\n---\nauthor: \nid: F_95\ninternalId: e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71\ntitle: integrate into project should track commit\nstatus: ready\nowner: \naffects:\nagents:\n  - design/activity/card__e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71.json#conversation=agent-4e6f97b9-647e-49fc-93f7-cf09e5eff1aa\npolicy:\nafter: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\n---\n\n## Current state\n\n`WorktreeSelector` integrates an assigned card through `WorktreeService` and the Electron worktree service. The backend checkpoints primary-worktree changes, rebases the card branch when behind, then fast-forwards the project branch. The operation returns no commit metadata.\n\nCard commit history reads tracked `<projectFolder>/activity/card__<cardInternalId>.json` files. Only action executions add commit references, so commits integrated from the selector are absent unless an action already recorded them.\n\n## Implementation details\n\n- Add a card-specific integration request containing `cardInternalId` and `projectFolder`; project-level worktree integration remains untracked.\n- After any rebase, squash the card branch's complete change onto the project branch and create one integration commit. Do not fast-forward or retain the card branch's individual commits on the project branch.\n- Resolve the integration commit's activity metadata, then append one system activity record containing only that commit and labeled `Integrate into project` to the card's primary-checkout activity file. Do not model it as a user action.\n- Commit the activity-file update through the existing serialized activity writer. Return only after both integration and history persistence finish, so existing card-history reload and diff UI show the integration commit.\n- If applying or committing the squash fails, restore the primary checkout to its state after the primary-worktree checkpoint and before the squash attempt.\n- Failed integration writes no activity record. If integration succeeds but activity persistence fails, report that partial failure clearly; never claim tracking succeeded.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- Integrating a card worktree with one or several outgoing commits creates and records exactly one squash commit under the card's stable `internalId`.\n- The squash commit contains the combined change between the project branch and the rebased card branch. Primary checkpoint and activity-file commits are not included.\n- The squash commit appears once under `Integrate into project` in the existing card commit selector and opens one combined diff for the integration.\n- Integration with no outgoing commits or no combined change remains rejected and creates no activity record.\n- Failed integration creates no activity record. History-persistence failure after a successful squash commit is visible.\n- Project-level worktree integration creates no card activity.\n- Tests cover one and several source commits producing one squash commit, rebase before integration, stable card ownership, squash cleanup and persistence failure paths, and project-level exclusion.\n\r\n\n===== design\\releases\\0_0_4\\F_96_ctrl_enter_on_action_input.md =====\r\n---\nauthor: \nid: F_96\ninternalId: d33002d3-ee0e-4c08-8e26-36f790500ee2\ntitle: ctrl enter on action input\nstatus: ready\nowner: \naffects:\nagents:\npolicy:\nafter: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\n---\n\nwhen pressing ctrl + enter on action input, the input is sent, this is good, but before this happens, the input box still adds an enter, which should not be the case.\n\n# Current state\n\n`ActionAgentPrompt` handles `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` on the prompt wrapper during event bubbling. MDXEditor handles `Enter` first, inserts a newline, then the wrapper flushes and sends the changed prompt.\n\n# Implementation details\n\n- Intercept `Ctrl+Enter` and `Meta+Enter` during capture, before MDXEditor handles the key.\n- Prevent default behavior and stop propagation, then flush the latest prompt before running the existing shortcut callback.\n- Keep plain `Enter`, `Shift+Enter`, and disabled shortcut behavior unchanged.\n- Extend `action_agent_prompt.test.tsx` with regression coverage proving the editor does not receive the send shortcut.\n\n# Acceptance criteria\n\n- `Ctrl+Enter` sends current prompt without inserting a newline.\n- `Meta+Enter` has same behavior.\n- Prompt is flushed before send callback runs.\n- Plain `Enter` and `Shift+Enter` still insert newlines.\n\r\n",

Add optional `accessLevel` and `approvalPolicy` overrides to agent action definitions and run input. Resolution order is run override, action override, then desktop default.\n- Show profile-supported choices beside agent, model, and thinking level in config, action editor, and local run/chat controls. Reject unknown values, missing argument mappings, or values unsupported by selected agent before process start.\n- Add resolved arguments before one-shot, resume, and streaming subcommands. For built-in Codex, use `--sandbox <accessLevel>` and `--ask-for-approval <approvalPolicy>`; other profiles use their configured arguments without MDÂ² translating provider terms.\n- Propagate effective values through scheduled, chained, continued, local-bridge, and remote-control runs. Record them in execution events and action history.\n- Add profile, config persistence, action validation/editor, popup/controller, request-contract, command-building, execution, bridge, remote-control, continuation, and scheduling tests.\n\n## Acceptance criteria\n\n- Each agent exposes only its configured access levels and approval policies, using provider-specific names.\n- User can set global defaults, action overrides, and local run/chat overrides for both settings.\n- Run override wins over action override; action override wins over desktop default.\n- Codex receives exact resolved `--sandbox` and `--ask-for-approval` values for one-shot, resumed, and streaming runs.\n- Unsupported, stale, or malformed selections fail before process start with a clear error.\n- Switching agents cannot retain incompatible access or approval selections.\n- Scheduled, chained, continued, local, and remote runs use and report effective settings consistently.\n- Existing agent/model/thinking-level behavior, approval handling, and execution tests remain valid.\n\r\n\n===== F_111_remove_new_conv_led_upon_load_conv.md =====\r\n---\nauthor: \nid: F_111\ninternalId: 6fdba724-f0ab-484a-9831-0480bc6d5e8d\ntitle: remove new conv-led upon load conv\nstatus: ready\nowner: \naffects:\nagents:\n  - design/activity/card__6fdba724-f0ab-484a-9831-0480bc6d5e8d.json#conversation=agent-f72013d8-6964-4773-8e15-c3efcc2c41f0\npolicy:\nafter: 1b39ee56-e06e-4705-840f-7541b2a57d3d\n---\nWhen an agent is finished, we show a small blue led on the 'action' button in the `action-popup`. This is ok. However, it remains there for as long as the action popup remains open. Also, the user initially gets to see an empty chat window, which is confusing. So:\n\n* when an action completes while the chatlog of that action is active (so action-popup open and action button selected), then we should mark the log as `viewed`\n* when the user clicks on an action button that has a log still marked as `ready but not yet viewed`, then instead of showing an empty log history, immediately open the last log (that is marked as ready, not yet viewed).\n* as soon as the log is shown, remove the led from the action button. the log has been viewed, so lets show it this way.\n\n## Current state\n\n`agentAcknowledgementService` stores one completed-result checkpoint per card. `CardRunButton` derives unseen action IDs when opening a popup, and `CardActionPopupService` keeps that copied list for popup lifetime. `ActionConversationChat` acknowledges a completed conversation once rendered, but copied selector state does not update, so blue LED remains.\n\n`useActionPopupController` automatically restores latest waiting conversation only. Selecting action with unseen completed result therefore starts with empty chat until user selects history manually.\n\n## implementation details\n\n- Derive latest unseen completed conversation per action from current card conversations and acknowledgement checkpoint. Keep popup data reactive while open; remove frozen unseen-ID snapshot. Preserve existing local-storage format and card-level checkpoint semantics.\n- When user selects action with unseen results, load newest unseen conversation. Keep normal empty-conversation state for actions without unseen results and for explicit `Conversations` reset.\n- Acknowledge only after completed conversation is displayed. This covers action completing while selected and removes both action LED and card unseen indicator immediately.\n- Keep result unseen if conversation load fails and report existing load error.\n- Add acknowledgement-query, popup-selection, active-completion, multiple-result, and load-failure regression tests.\n\n## acceptance criteria\n\n- Clicking action with unseen results immediately shows newest unseen conversation; empty chat is not shown first.\n- Showing conversation clears action LED and card unseen-result indicator without closing popup.\n- Action completing while its chat is selected is marked viewed and leaves no LED.\n- Action completing while another action is selected remains marked unseen until opened.\n- Multiple unseen results open newest result; existing checkpoint marks it and older results viewed.\n- Failed load leaves result unseen and shows error.\n\r\n",

Layout and paint are small; synchronous React work consumes most of the time.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Cause\\r\\n\\r\\n`NewCardDialog` passes `handleBodyChange` to `MarkdownEditor.onLiveChange`. Every editor change calls `setBody`, rerendering the complete dialog and the MDXEditor subtree. This also recreates the Markdown editor plugin array and many MUI elements and style objects. Development-mode React work and garbage collection amplify the cost.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis bypasses the lifetime-stable editor approach already used by `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`. `MarkdownEditor` already buffers local edits and exposes `getMarkdown`, `setMarkdown`, and `flush`; normal typing does not need to propagate the full body into parent React state.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Keep the new-card Markdown editor lifetime-stable while typing, following `CardEditor` and `CardBodyEditor`.\\r\\n- Do not store the full Markdown body in `NewCardDialog` state on every keystroke.\\r\\n- Read the current body from the editor when submitting, checking whether the draft is dirty, and inserting or clearing the template.\\r\\n- Preserve existing template behavior: untouched template can be cleared; editing it changes the action back to `Template`; inserting then appends without discarding text.\\r\\n- Keep reset, cancel confirmation, `Ctrl+Enter`, and target-column behavior unchanged.\\r\\n- Do not change shared `MarkdownEditor` buffering semantics solely for this dialog.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Typing in the new-card description does not rerender `NewCardDialog` or remount/rerender the Markdown editor for every keystroke.\\r\\n- [ ] Submitted card body exactly matches current editor content.\\r\\n- [ ] Cancel confirmation detects description-only edits.\\r\\n- [ ] Template insert, clear, edit, and append behavior remains unchanged.\\r\\n- [ ] Opening, closing, successful creation, and project changes reset the draft correctly.\\r\\n- [ ] A regression test verifies repeated description edits do not repeatedly render the editor boundary.\\r\\n- [ ] Existing new-card dialog and Markdown editor tests pass.\\r\\n\\n===== B_82_orphaned_git_for_windows_processes.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor:\\r\\nid: B_82\\r\\ninternalId: d97a054f-5a67-47bb-9070-df874cf9148e\\r\\ntitle: agent runs leave orphaned Git for Windows processes\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner:\\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Problem\\r\\n\\r\\nAgent runs launched through MDÂ² can leave multiple `git.exe` processes running indefinitely. The processes appear as **Git for Windows** in Task Manager and accumulate across runs.\\r\\n\\r\\nObserved processes were executing normally short-lived commands such as `config`, `rev-parse`, `remote -v`, and `status --porcelain`. They remained alive after their immediate parent processes had exited.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current implementation\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÂ² starts agents through `AgentRunnerService`. When an agent closes normally, `handleClose` queries the current Windows process tree and terminates descendants of the agent PID. Cancellation terminates the process tree with `taskkill /t /f`.\\r\\n\\r\\nThis cleanup cannot discover a surviving Git process after an intermediate parent has already exited: the current process snapshot no longer contains a complete chain from the agent PID to that Git process. The observed Git processes had dead immediate parents, matching this failure mode.\\r\\n\\r\\nMDÂ² also invokes Git directly through `git_commands.js`. These calls have no timeout or cancellation handling, so an independently hung app-owned Git command can block its caller indefinitely.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Investigation plan\\r\\n\\r\\n1. Reproduce with MDÂ² open but no agent run, then while starting and completing or cancelling an agent run.\\r\\n2. Record every spawned Git PID, command, working directory, parent PID, agent run ID, and lifecycle event.\\r\\n3. Run an affected command under a bounded external timeout with Git tracing enabled to locate the blocking operation.\\r\\n4. Check repository state, Git configuration, filesystem monitoring, antivirus or file locks, and agent shutdown ordering.\\r\\n5. Confirm whether Git descendants become disconnected before `AgentRunnerService.handleClose` takes its process snapshot.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Required change\\r\\n\\r\\n- Track enough process ownership during an agent run to terminate surviving descendants even when intermediate processes exit before final cleanup.\\r\\n- Clean up owned descendants when an agent completes, fails, is cancelled, or crashes.\\r\\n- Do not terminate unrelated Git processes or Git work started outside the corresponding MDÂ² agent run.\\r\\n- Add a bounded timeout and process cleanup to direct Git execution in `git_commands.js`.\\r\\n- Include the command, working directory, elapsed time, and owning run or app operation in timeout diagnostics.\\r\\n- Deduplicate or serialize repeated read-only metadata probes only if tracing confirms they contribute to the accumulation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Failure modes and compatibility\\r\\n\\r\\n- PID reuse must not allow cleanup to target a process that MDÂ² did not start.\\r\\n- Cleanup must cover shell and helper-process chains used by Git for Windows on Windows.\\r\\n- Long-running network Git operations need an explicit, suitable timeout rather than the same threshold as local metadata commands.\\r\\n- Existing agent cancellation, command actions, commits, worktree operations, push, pull, and fetch behavior must remain unchanged apart from bounded failure and cleanup.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- [ ] Completing, failing, cancelling, or crashing an agent run leaves no Git processes owned by that run.\\r\\n- [ ] Repeated agent runs do not accumulate Git for Windows processes.\\r\\n\\n===== B_85_add_the_reference_to_a_chatlog_to_a_card_as_soon_as_possible.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: B_85\\r\\ninternalId: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\ntitle: add the reference to a chatlog to a card as soon as possible\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - After history is selected, `handleConversationChange` only loads persisted paths, so popup cannot return to empty conversation state.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Keep empty `Conversations` item selectable while picker is enabled.\\r\\n- Treat empty value as reset: clear selected conversation and displayed chat without calling conversation loader.\\r\\n- Next run omits `continueFrom` and starts new conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- User can select `Conversations` after selecting historical conversation.\\r\\n- Popup returns to empty conversation without error or empty-path load.\\r\\n- Next run starts new conversation; selecting history still continues selected conversation.\\r\\n- Picker and controller tests cover reset and continuation behavior.\\r\\n\\n===== F_115_add_support_for_request_approval.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_115\\r\\ninternalId: 7bdf27fc-963c-4545-83e2-93410e67f0e3\\r\\ntitle: add support for request approval\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 56dd54b0-9554-4545-85d4-bb45efef4d6e\\r\\n---\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`CodexStreamingAdapter` handles structured questions, but not Codex app-server approval requests. `item/fileChange/requestApproval` and `item/commandExecution/requestApproval` fall through as protocol diagnostics, for example `item/fileChange/requestApproval: unknown (...)`. No approval UI or JSON-RPC response exists, so the turn remains blocked.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Handle both approval methods as server-initiated JSON-RPC requests before notification handling. Validate request, item, thread, and turn ids; track pending requests by request id; clear them on `serverRequest/resolved`.\\r\\n- Add a dedicated approval contract through `AgentRunnerService`, action execution events, Electron preload/local bridge, and remote control. Respond with `{ decision }`; for command requests, honor `availableDecisions` when supplied. Keep approvals separate from structured questions and conversation messages.\\r\\n- Store pending approvals in `ActionExecutionService`. Keep execution `waitingForInput` while any question or approval remains. Replay must restore unresolved approvals and discard resolved ones after renderer reload.\\r\\n- Add a separate popup approval component. Show reason plus command, working directory, parsed actions, network host/protocol, requested permissions, or affected file paths when available. Actions sit bottom-right: allow once, allow for session, decline, and stop turn. Show policy-amendment choices only when Codex supplies them.\\r\\n- Support multiple pending approvals without overwriting one another. Disable a submitted request until response or resolution; reject duplicate, stale, mismatched, or unsupported decisions clearly.\\r\\n- Do not persist approval requests or decisions in conversation/activity files or agent handoff context. Existing completed command/file activity remains authoritative.\\r\\n- Add adapter, runner, execution-contract, bridge, remote-control, service, popup, reload, and regression tests. Run lint and tests in `desktop/` and `app/`.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- File-change and command-execution approval requests show actionable prompts instead of protocol diagnostics.\\r\\n- Allow once/session, decline, stop-turn, and offered policy-amendment choices send the exact matching JSON-RPC decision and unblock Codex.\\r\\n- Approval UI shows available security context before user decides, including network-specific context when present.\\r\\n- Concurrent requests remain isolated; `serverRequest/resolved`, turn completion, or cancellation removes only matching pending requests.\\r\\n- Renderer reload and remote-control clients retain correct pending approval state.\\r\\n- Structured questions, activity ordering, changed-path tracking, and conversation persistence keep existing behavior; approval data is not persisted.\\r\\n\\n===== F_89_add_support_for_clicking_on_links_in_chatlogs.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_89\\r\\ninternalId: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\\r\\ntitle: add support for clicking on links in chatlogs\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: e69b9faf-30dd-4ad6-9d99-7e6af4d18c76\\r\\n---\\r\\nSometimes the agent produces a link to a local project file. Normalize separators and convert paths inside the active repository to repository-relative paths.\\r\\n- When the target is inside configured `projectFolder` and is either a Markdown file or a loaded action-definition JSON file, switch to list view and open its existing Markdown or action editor.\\r\\n- Open every other local project file in VS Code through the Electron bridge. absolute Windows links to Markdown files under configured `projectFolder` opens them in list view with the Markdown editor.\\r\\n- Clicking relative or absolute Windows links to action-definition JSON files under configured `projectFolder` opens them in list view with the action editor.\\r\\n- Clicking another local project-file link opens that file in VS Code.\\r\\n- Invalid, missing, or light/dark toggle top-right).\\r\\nStyle tokens and component conventions: `STYLE_GUIDE.md`.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Why\\r\\n\\r\\nThe current dialog is low-value and hard to scan:\\r\\n\\r\\n* The markdown static text, so the target column can't be changed without closing the dialog.\\r\\n* Net result: lots of empty space, little usefulness.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Scope\\r\\n\\r\\nTwo presentations of the same form and the same state:\\r\\n\\r\\n* **Desktop** â€” centered modal dialog over a scrim.\\r\\n* **Mobile** â€” full-height sheet.\\r\\n\\r\\nSame fields, same validation, same submit behavior. Type â€” single-select pill row\\r\\n\\r\\n* Replaces the dropdown with one-click pills.\\r\\n* **Types are dynamic.** Render one pill per type from the app's existing type source (same source the board/card already uses). Do not hard-code type names, count, or order â€” the row must work for 2 types or 12.\\r\\n* **Colors are dynamic.** Each pill shows a small round dot (8px) filled with that type's own color, taken from the type record. Never hard-code hex values per type; if a type has no color, fall back to a neutral token (`--text-4`).\\r\\n* Selected state: tinted background + border in the app's primary token, primary text color. Unselected: subtle track background, secondary text, transparent border; hover raises contrast.\\r\\n* Default selection: the app's existing default type (first in the list if there is no configured default).\\r\\n* Overflow: desktop wraps to multiple lines; mobile scrolls horizontally in one row (no wrap, no visible scrollbar chrome).\\r\\n* Keyboard: arrow keys move between pills, Space/Enter selects; the row is a single tab stop (radiogroup semantics â€” `role=\\\"radiogroup\\\"` with `role=\\\"radio\\\"` + `aria-checked` children).\\r\\n\\r\\n\\n===== F_91_remove_finished_reasoning_blocks.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_91\\r\\ninternalId: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\\r\\ntitle: remove finished reasoning blocks\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: eb3a4820-0edb-4161-8fe5-926a981d2c8f\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nwhen a reasoning output of an agent finishes, we should remove the block\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\nCodex reasoning is stored as an `AgentConversationEvent`. Streaming updates replace the same event by `providerItemId`, changing its status from `inProgress` to `completed`. `ActionConversationChat` currently renders every reasoning event, so completed reasoning blocks remain visible during the live run and in reopened conversations. Failed and declined reasoning already use the error presentation.\\r\\n\\r\\n## implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Filter conversation feed activities in `ActionConversationChat`: omit only events where `type === 'reasoning'` and `status === 'completed'`.\\r\\n- Keep in-progress, failed, declined and unknown-status reasoning visible.\\r\\n- Keep completed reasoning events in conversation data and persisted history; this is a presentation-only change.\\r\\n- Update chat tests for live completion, reopened conversations, failed/declined reasoning and unaffected non-reasoning activities.\\r\\n\\r\\n## acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- In-progress reasoning is visible.\\r\\n- A reasoning block disappears when its status becomes `completed`, including after reopening a conversation.\\r\\n- Failed and declined reasoning remains visible with its error state and content.\\r\\n- Completed non-reasoning activities remain visible.\\r\\n\\n===== F_94_no_prefill_prompt_running_conv.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_94\\r\\ninternalId: d4afff38-5581-42f4-a8f3-8ded807ab27a\\r\\ntitle: no prefill prompt running conv\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 3ffa4da3-1e0f-4930-ad38-6bf247b13c52\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\nWhen an agent is waiting for a response, but the action popup was closed or on the wrong 'action', then when the user clicks on the action to view the conversation and answer, the input box is prefilled again with the action's prompt. this is annoying cause it needs to be removed.\\r\\n\\r\\nso, when activating an action that has a running conversation, don't prefill the input\\r\\n\\r\\n# Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`useActionPopupController` prepares an action's stored prompt for a new conversation. When popup opens on another action, or reopens while execution state is being restored, that prepared prompt can remain in `promptState` when user selects action with a `queued`, `running`, or `waitingForInput` conversation.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Give active execution its own prompt identity, including before active-child metadata arrives.\\r\\n- When active action is selected, seed editor only from its shared user-entered draft; otherwise show empty input.\\r\\n- Invalidate pending prompt preparation and bump `promptResetToken` when action becomes active.\\r\\n- Keep stored-prompt prefill for idle actions starting new conversations. Keep command actions unchanged.\\r\\n\\r\\n# Acceptance criteria\\r\\n\\r\\n- Selecting or reopening action with active conversation does not prefill its stored action prompt.\\r\\n- Existing user-entered draft for active conversation is restored.\\r\\n- Late prompt-preparation result cannot overwrite active conversation input.\\r\\n- Idle agent actions still prefill stored prompt.\\r\\n- Controller and popup tests cover action switching, popup reopen, draft restore, and preparation race.\\r\\n\\n===== F_95_integrate_into_project_should_track_commit.md =====\\r\\n---\\r\\nauthor: \\r\\nid: F_95\\r\\ninternalId: e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71\\r\\ntitle: integrate into project should track commit\\r\\nstatus: ready\\r\\nowner: \\r\\naffects:\\r\\nagents:\\r\\n  - design/activity/card__e5b95f2c-cd0c-4623-8e12-d0c497447e71.json#conversation=agent-4e6f97b9-647e-49fc-93f7-cf09e5eff1aa\\r\\npolicy:\\r\\nafter: 9ef42f8e-d6f7-4514-8e4a-5555318c4b51\\r\\n---\\r\\n\\r\\n## Current state\\r\\n\\r\\n`WorktreeSelector` integrates an assigned card through `WorktreeService` and the Electron worktree service. The backend checkpoints primary-worktree changes, rebases the card branch when behind, then fast-forwards the project branch. Only action executions add commit references, so commits integrated from the selector are absent unless an action already recorded them.\\r\\n\\r\\n## Implementation details\\r\\n\\r\\n- Add a card-specific integration request containing `cardInternalId` and `projectFolder`; project-level worktree integration remains untracked.\\r\\n- After any rebase, squash the card branch's complete change onto the project branch and create one integration commit.
